canon_ref.note: Remote thread on Chandrar; day number reuses the nearest Liscor day as a rough placeholder, not a confirmed sync (as with Niers Astoragon's Baleros scenes).

b2.gazi_returns_to_reim.summary: Gazi returns through her portal to King Flos's court in Reim, part of a kingdom just waking after twenty-two idle years of grief.

b2.mars_and_takhatres_return_to_reim.summary: Two more of Flos's Seven, Mars the Illusionist and Takhatres the Garuda, Lord of the Skies, have also made their way back to Reim.

b2.gazi_reveals_erins_immortal_moment.summary: Gazi recounts her stay at the Wandering Inn to the war council, revealing that innkeeper Erin Solstice has a unique skill, [Immortal Moment], and that Erin herself put out Gazi's eye.

b2.empire_of_sands_sends_drevishs_head.news: The Empire of Sands sent King Flos Reimarch of Reim the severed, ice-preserved head of Drevish the Architect, one of his Seven. Flos has declared open war.
b2.empire_of_sands_sends_drevishs_head.summary: The rising Empire of Sands sends Flos the severed, ice-preserved head of his ally Drevish the Architect. Flos declares open war on the Empire.
